My name is Nicolas Cole, and I am one of the most-read writers on the Internet.

Over the past decade, I have written over 5,000 articles online, and ghostwritten for 300+ Founders, C-level executives, NYT best-selling authors, Grammy-winning musicians, and more. I have also broken records on various digital writing platforms, like becoming the fastest-growing user on Quora in 2014, and becoming the most-read writer on the entire platform (out of 200 million users) in 2015. I have amassed hundreds of millions of views on my writing, and the topics I cover include hard life advice, category design, and digital writing principles.

I have also written over a dozen books, including the best-selling The Art & Business of Online Writing.

I am passionate about paying it forward and sharing what I have learned writing online for more than decade with other writers, creators, and industry leaders.

Here's a quick breakdown of my portfolio of companies, and how to get in touch.

WANT TO GET STARTED WRITING ONLINE?

→ GO HERE: www.ship30for30.com

Ship 30 for 30 is a cohort-based community specifically for people who want to start writing online. In this 4-week program, we help you build your daily writing habit, launch your Social Blog, clarify your niche, and master the fundamentals of digital writing. To date, we have helped more than 3,000 people get started writing online.

WANT TO BECOME A PREMIUM GHOSTWRITER?

→ GO HERE: https://premiumghostwritingacademy.com

Freelance writers charge per word or per hour. As a result, they're underpaid and burned out. Premium Ghostwriters charge per project, work directly with founders, CEOs, and business owners, and are more like "business consultants who happen to know how to write." As a result, they can charge a premium. In PGA, our Premium Ghostwriting Academy, we train writers on how to become Premium Ghostwriters, and learn how to package & price their services in lucrative ways.

WANT TO STAY AT THE FOREFRONT OF WRITING WITH AI?

→ GO HERE: https://writewithai.substack.com

Write With AI is a bi-weekly paid newsletters for writers, giving you strategies and prompts to help you turn ChatGPT into your own personal Digital Writing Assistant. 

WANT TO GET IN TOUCH?

→ GO HERE: www.nicolascole.com

In addition to writing and building my own businesses, I am also an investor & advisor to a handful of media & digital publishing companies. If you'd like to get in touch, please feel free to shoot me an email.

Email: cole@nicolascole.com
Twitter: @Nicolascole77

items.about:
I bring over 25 years of experience in engineering, maintenance, and project execution across multiple industries. My journey began as a Mechanical Engineer working on sugar mill dismantling, and evolved into leading engineering teams and managing critical utility systems in organizations like Zydus Cadila Healthcare and Indoco Remedies Limited.
  
Throughout my career, one principle has remained constant: every process can be improved.
  
Today, I am focused on helping organizations build that improvement culture through 5S and Kaizen.
  
I am currently pursuing my Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification and actively working towards applying these principles through training, consulting, and coaching, especially for MSMEs looking for simple, practical improvements.
  
My approach is not theoretical. It is grounded in real shopfloor experience:
  
Managing utilities like chillers and boilers in regulated environments 
Improving equipment uptime through preventive maintenance systems 
Leading teams through operational challenges 
Executing complex projects like the relocation of a complete sugar mill during my time at Badami Sugars Limited 
  
These experiences shaped my belief that sustainable improvement starts with discipline, workplace organization, and small daily changes.
  
That is why I am passionate about:
  
Implementing 5S systems that actually sustain 
Driving Kaizen culture through simple, repeatable practices 
Conducting practical, hands-on training for teams 
Supporting leaders in building accountability on the shop floor 
  
Beyond consulting, I enjoy mentoring aspiring engineers and sharing practical insights on Lean thinking.
  
If you are looking to bring structure, clarity, and continuous improvement into your operations, let’s connect.
  
📩 niranjanpk1@gmail.com
